note: enhancement = mean focus intensity / mean of the background regions, re-measured on the final pattern with 50 fresh shots (enhancement_end_of_search is the biased number seen during the search). The search maximises focus/background, so the ring background can fall as well as the focus rising: focus_gain = focus after / focus before, background_ratio = background after / background before. enhancement_vs_far_field is the same focus intensity divided by the mean over camera pixels outside the ring that the search never used (a check that the enhancement is not only a lowered ring). textbook_N_over_2pi is the usual estimate for N binary-amplitude macropixels when the background stays unchanged.
